mythology: The Ashtadasha Shakti Peetha Stotram names Shankari in Lanka. Local Koneswaram traditions link Ravana to the fissure in Swami Rock and worship of Shiva.
pilgrimage_significance: The Shankari tradition is associated with this site. The living Koneswaram temple venerates Koneswarar and Mathumai Amman.
historical_notes: The historic complex was destroyed in the Portuguese period. The temple at the tip of Swami Rock was rebuilt in the twentieth century and continues as a place of worship.
